note: Concrete tensor contracts behind TaskProfile.slots[].inputSchemaRef / outputSchemaRef. Every field below is a decision the runner can actually enforce: experiments/phase2-cpu-seg-v1/runner.py checks logits shape (batchSize, numClasses), torch.isfinite on logits and loss, and the module contract [B, 8, H, W] float32 that fixtures/modules/manifest.json already declares for module-aspp-v1 and module-se-v1.

dynamicDims.name: batch
dynamicDims.reason: the profile's fixed runner reads batchSize=4 from the manifest and refuses a logits shape other than (batchSize, numClasses)

mask.semantics: none: features.pre_pool in this profile carries no attention/validity mask. An operator that requires a mask argument cannot be bound here, because the pinned baseline calls self.pre_pool(h) with a single tensor (experiments/stitch-cpu-v1/model.py).

batch.semantics: contiguous slice of the deterministic CPU dataset, taken in a fixed order
batch.source: runner.py get_batch equivalent: batch index = step % (sampleCount // batchSize)

label.semantics: not carried at this slot: features.pre_pool sees activations only. Labels are consumed by CrossEntropyLoss at the logits stage.

values.finiteness: required: the pinned runner raises on non-finite activations upstream; a module that emits NaN/Inf fails the run, not a tolerance

dynamicDims.name: batch
dynamicDims.reason: shape-preserving: a module that changes the batch axis breaks the downstream pool/flatten/Linear chain

mask.semantics: none: a module must not emit a mask side-channel at this slot; the baseline discards anything but a single tensor

batch.semantics: unchanged from the input batch axis

shapePreservation.reason: the downstream path is AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1,1)) -> flatten -> Linear(8, 2). A module that changes C, H or W changes the Linear input width and the pinned baseline weights stop applying, which would silently make the baseline arm non-comparable.

schema:phase2.features.pre_pool.output.v.channelRule: C must stay 8. A module needing an internal projection must project back to 8 channels (both pinned modules do).
